attempt.consumes: the item, success or failure; the attempt itself is a #269 deed either way
attempt.requires: snag-class capture item (#31 flag); target on the field; target's keeper present in the battle
attempt.roll: #38 staged checks with two declared, visible modifiers: snagPenalty (item data) and bondResistance (target's #39 bond to its true keeper, read as a value)

confirmationGate.appliesTo: player-initiated snag attempts against an owned target in a Ranger battle
confirmationGate.law: the throw never fires on the input alone; because every attempt is confirmed, every attempt is deliberate — there is no accidental-theft state
confirmationGate.onConfirm: the throw proceeds as specified; a failed throw writes #269's attempted-theft deed; #272 witnesses read a confirmed attempt as the act's opening
confirmationGate.onDecline: cancelled whole — no item consumed, no throw, no deed, no record; backing out at the conscience beat is free by design
confirmationGate.prompt: Are you sure you want to try and steal this person's Mochi?
confirmationGate.promptSource: owner's drafted words (2026-10-27); see Owner addendum — the confirmation in 268-SNAG-SYSTEM.md
confirmationGate.rescueShape: against a closed-heart target (#287's heart read), the same throw prompts as rescue — the device states what it sees (the heart is closed) and the confirmation frames rescue; a confirmed rescue attempt carries no morale cost and writes no theft vocabulary

lawfulMirror: re-snagging your own stolen Mochi is restitution (#269's strongest good deed), appends a recovered entry answering the theft, and is never read as a crime (#272)
note: Shape only — zero snag-class items instanced; the class flag is proposed into #31's registry and the theft history kind into #168's file (STAGING step 3).
npcUse: #99 tiers carry snag-class equipment as party data (grunt weak, admin set-piece); identical math, bond resistance, and history stamp; a successful NPC snag removes the record from the player's keeping — recovery is #273, not a reload

historyAppends.law: permanent and uneditable — provenance (#227) always shows it; distinct from #168 trade and #217 gift, which are consents

onSuccess.keepingState: individual gains stolen state with trueKeeper cited (#273)

ownedBlock: #38 rule: a target with a filled keeper seat refuses an ordinary attempt before any roll; wild targets (empty seat, incl. #267 pooled individuals) are never blocked and never stolen
protections: story-locked individuals (#68) cannot be snagged — the lock bars theft as it bars escrow and release
